events.text:
The fix is already applied in the working copy (changed `i <= values.length` → `i < values.length`). Let me commit it.**Fixed.** The off-by-one error was in the loop boundary of `sum()` in `src/utils.ts`:

| | Code |
|---|---|
| **Before (buggy)** | `for (let i = 0; i <= values.length; i++)` |
| **After (fixed)** | `for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++)` |

The `<=` caused the loop to run one extra iteration, accessing `values[values.length]` which is `undefined`, turning `total` into `NaN`. The fix changes it to strict `<`, so only valid indices `0` to `length - 1` are accessed. Tests pass.
